summary: The team is juggling urgent email security fixes, a knowledge website redesign, and a strategic pivot to prioritize China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for marketing, while also managing several October deadlines.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most critical issue is the Outlook account lockout: the team must delete and re-login to email accounts on all devices, check home devices, and confirm with JSB that the backend lock is lifted. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward with Joseph sharing the HTML file, a feedback meeting scheduled, and Joker implementing changes; key decisions include removing the video section, dispersing videos by topic, and incorporating BCI/BSI index banners. On the strategic front, the global marketing team has decided to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with Joseph drafting a plan and the team analyzing participant profiles and requesting a conversion tracking brief; US partnerships are on hold. For October, several items need attention: Ira and Julie must review the newsletter draft and EuroCham Shanghai proposal, Julie must confirm SproutVideo renewal and check a paper, Joseph and Julie must finalize the CKGSB Americas website reply, and Ira must review the invitation email for Professor Hong Wang. Additionally, the team must submit explanations for the September attendance sheet, and the PRME SIP 2026 report will be submitted as is.
